title.narrative: PERFORMANCE-BASED PARTNERSHIP SCHEME FOCUSING ON QUALITY PROGRAMMING, UNDERSTANDING CHANGE AND RESULTS FOR POOR HOUSEHOLDS AND COMMUNITIES

description.narrative:
To bring about the realisation of human rights for poor and marginalised men and women affected by high inequality, human rights violations and violence in seven conflict or post-conflict countries by addressing issues of governance, tackling violence, building peace and promoting equality for all, particularly gender equality Outcome 2.1: A safe environment and protection for communities affected by violence is provided by municipal governments and public institutions.
Outcome 2.2: The State improves its response and protection on violence and on the violation of human rights by security forces, including increased/ring-fenced resources for public institutions and having a more integrated approach to violence prevention. Objective 2: Marginalised women and men facing violence have greater safety, security and resilience, and inclusive peace building initiatives contribute to lasting justice.
